title: The UN-backed World Happiness Report says passively consuming algorithmic social media hurts teens' mental health, disproportionately affecting girls (Kati Pohjanpalo/Bloomberg)
summary: Kati Pohjanpalo / Bloomberg: The UN-backed World Happiness Report says passively consuming algorithmic social media hurts teens' mental health, disproportionately affecting girls — Passively consuming algorithmic social media hurts teens' mental health, according to the World Happiness Report for 2026 …
